data.one_liner: Renders DOCX files using native Flutter widgets without WebView or PDF conversion.
data.what_it_does: A high-fidelity native Flutter DOCX viewer that renders Word documents using pure Flutter widgets. Supports viewing, zooming, searching, text selection, and document themes.
use_when: You need to display Word (.docx) documents directly inside a Flutter application without relying on WebViews or PDF conversion.
Users need features like search, pinch-to-zoom, and text selection on DOCX files.
avoid_when: You need to edit and save changes back to Word documents.
strengths: Pure Flutter rendering with no external WebView or PDF conversion required.
Supports text search, pinch-to-zoom, text selection, headers, footers, tables, and lists.
